appearance.subtle: Their left arm hangs slightly wrong.
appearance.obvious: There is an extra joint halfway down their left forearm, and it flexes when they reach.
appearance.extreme: Their left arm folds in three places. When they reach across the table it arrives from an angle that makes you sit back.

description: An additional joint partway down one arm. It bends where nothing should bend, and it reaches where nothing should reach.
name: Extra Joint
